news_project package
====================

The news_project package contains the main Django project configuration.

Submodules
----------

news_project.settings module
----------------------------

Contains the main Django settings, including installed apps, middleware, database settings, static file settings, authentication settings, and REST framework configuration.

news_project.urls module
------------------------

Contains the root URL configuration for the Django project.

news_project.wsgi module
------------------------

Provides the WSGI application used for deployment.

news_project.asgi module
------------------------

Provides the ASGI application used for asynchronous deployment support.
